s.note: Baked oysters under buttery greens and crumbs.
s.how: Blitz the butter, spring onions, spinach, parsley and fennel to a green paste and season. Spread the rock salt on a tray and nestle the oysters in it. Top each oyster with a spoon of green butter, then the crumbs mixed with parmesan. Bake at 230C until bubbling and golden, and serve with lemon.

s.note: Buttermilk fried chicken with honey hot sauce.
s.how: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt. Mix the flour with the paprika, garlic powder and pepper, and dredge the chicken well. Fry in oil at 170C in batches until deep golden and cooked through. Warm the honey with the Tabasco and drizzle over the hot chicken.

m.note: Rare roast sirloin with Yorkshire puddings.
m.how: Rub the beef with oil, salt and pepper and roast at 220C, then turn down to 180C until rare in the middle. Brush with the mustard and rest under foil. Whisk the flour, eggs and milk to a smooth batter. Heat the dripping in a muffin tray at 230C, pour in the batter and bake until tall and crisp. Carve the beef thinly and serve with the puddings and horseradish.
shop: 4 tbsp beef dripping or vegetable oil@Pantry

m.note: Lobster in a paprika cream sauce on buttered toast.
m.how: Warm the lobster gently in the butter, then add the lemon juice. Whisk the cream with the yolks, pour in and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon. Season with the cayenne, paprika and salt. Toast and butter the bread, spoon over the lobster and finish with chives.

w.note: Snowy meringue piled with raspberries and cream.
w.how: Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Fold in the cornflour and vinegar and pile into a round on a lined tray. Bake at 120C, then turn off the oven and let it cool inside. Whip the cream, spread over the top, pile on the raspberries and dust with icing sugar like snow.

d.note: Rye whiskey and ginger beer with lemon peel.
d.how: Fill 4 highball glasses with ice and add 60ml rye to each. Top with ginger beer and twist a strip of lemon peel over each.

shopping: 4 tbsp beef dripping or vegetable oil@Pantry
